readings.Aries: Your courage is not in question. Neither is the value of strategic patience. This is a better week for listening than speaking.
readings.Taurus: Something is asking you to change. Your resistance is understandable. It is also, right now, the problem. Something you've been measuring incorrectly just corrected itself.
readings.Gemini: There is a thread you dropped three weeks ago that still leads somewhere worth going. Sleep on it before committing.
readings.Cancer: The tide moves regardless of whether you're watching. What you feel today will shift. Let it. The connection you almost didn't make is the one that matters.
readings.Leo: You contain more generosity than you sometimes access. Today, go deeper. Act from the calmest part of yourself.
readings.Virgo: There's a problem you're solving with effort that could be solved with a single honest conversation. Notice what hasn't changed, not just what has.
readings.Libra: The relationship that looks perfect from the outside is not being perceived from the inside. Which is true? Act from the calmest part of yourself.
readings.Scorpio: The loyalty you extend to your own past version of events — check whether those events still hold. There's more support available than you've asked for.
readings.Sagittarius: Something you know through experience — not theory — is what's needed right now. The week ahead rewards preparation you can still do today.
readings.Capricorn: The long game is yours to play and you play it well. There are also things that must be done today. Let this one be easy.
readings.Aquarius: Something about the past that you've analysed and filed away is asking to be felt, not just understood. The question matters more than the answer right now.
readings.Pisces: Your relationship with reality is flexible by nature. Today, anchor to something concrete. The week ahead rewards preparation you can still do today.

sky_notes: Saturn appears retrograde today. Earth is overtaking Saturn — an apparent backwards loop that happens every year for ~4.5 months. Plan your timecourse accordingly (or don't).
Uranus appears retrograde today. Uranus spends ~5 months of every year appearing to go backwards because Earth laps it. It's tilted 98°, so it's used to looking odd.
Neptune appears retrograde today. Neptune appears retrograde ~5 months a year as Earth laps it. Light from Neptune takes ~4 hours to reach you, so this news is already old.
Waxing gibbous: more than half lit and growing. The Moon is also moving ~3.8 cm further from Earth every year — budget accordingly.
Mars and Jupiter are within 2° of each other in the sky — a line-of-sight coincidence; in reality they are hundreds of millions of km apart.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: geocentric, from JPL Keplerian elements (Standish, valid 1800–2050) + Meeus ch.25/47 for Sun & Moon; checked against PyEphem to within 0.5°
Positions are for ~midday Sydney time on the stated date (tropical zodiac, equinox of date)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign

readings.Aries: Your instinct to protect the people around you is real. Make sure they know it's protection and not control. Saying less will move this further than saying more.
readings.Taurus: Your relationship with pleasure is complicated in a way that has nothing to do with pleasure. What worked before will not work the same way this time.
readings.Gemini: Your nervous system processes faster than most. Give yourself time to integrate before you act. There's more support available than you've asked for.
readings.Cancer: The thing you've outgrown is still in your possession. It's okay to let it go. Something is about to become obvious.
readings.Leo: The thing you've been making is almost ready. Your perfectionism is the only thing delaying it. The timing is better than it feels.
readings.Virgo: There is order inside the disorder. You will find it. Give yourself the time. One conversation today matters more than the rest combined.
readings.Libra: You've been mediating a situation that doesn't require a mediator — it requires a participant. You already have what you need to take the next step.
readings.Scorpio: You are harder to hurt than you used to be. Some of that armour is now in the way. Saying less will move this further than saying more.
readings.Sagittarius: There is a pattern in the places you leave and why. Worth examining before the next departure. Something is about to become obvious.
readings.Capricorn: Your patience is a form of power. Today, deploy it on yourself. Small, deliberate, and patient — that's the mode today.
readings.Aquarius: You process the world through systems. There is one person who doesn't fit the system and you keep thinking about them. That's data. Something is about to become obvious.
readings.Pisces: You dissolve into the spaces you inhabit. Make sure the space deserves you. You already have what you need to take the next step.
